{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Hawaii|Cuisine of Hawaii]]

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Hamburger|hamburger]] patty
* ½–1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] uncooked [[Cookbook:rice|rice]] (per preference)
* [[Cookbook:Gravy|Gravy]]

==Procedure==
# Cook the eggs sunny side up.
# Cook the hamburger to your preference.
# [[Cookbook:Steamed Rice|Steam]] the rice, and heat up the gravy. 
# Assemble the components in the following order:
#* Rice on bottom;
#* Hamburger on top of rice;
#* Eggs;
#* Gravy.
